title: Engineering change process: impact analysis
text: Every engineering change request lists affected variants, special tools, suppliers and applicable crash targets. Crash-relevant changes are signed by the responsible engineer and the passive safety owner.

title: Supplier change: production part approval
text: A change of supplier for a series part requires a production part approval at level 3 and the transfer of OEM-owned special tools to the new supplier. Tool transfer takes about six weeks.

title: Special tools: thickness and material changes
text: A press or trim die absorbs a sheet thickness change within its tolerance by rework. Beyond the tolerance, or for a material class it was not built for, a new die is required. Welding fixtures are not affected by thickness or material.

title: Approved materials list
text: Only materials on the approved list may be released for series production. EN AW-7075-T6 is not approved for body structures.
